method: Multi-source hierarchical time-series analysis combining data quality assessment, hierarchical aggregation verification, temporal pattern analysis, correlation analysis, building clustering (KMeans), load forecasting (Random Forest), and anomaly detection (Z-score)
data_sources: ASU Campus Metabolism Project sensor measurements (electricity, heat, cooling loads, PV generation, GHG emissions)
U.S. National Weather Service meteorological observations (temperature, dew point, humidity, wind speed, wind gust, pressure, precipitation)
time_period: 2014 (full year, hourly resolution, 8760 records per entity)
